exposure: scheduled cesarean delivery under neuraxial anesthesia
outcome: umbilical artery base deficit 12 mmol or greater
neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: Individuals who delivered a term, singleton, nonanomalous neonate at one of four academic medical centers in New York City from 2013 to 2019 by scheduled cesarean under neuraxial anesthesia for whom fetal cord blood gas results were available
finding: Maternal obesity is associated with increased odds of arterial pH less than 7.1 and base deficit 12 mmol or greater at the time of scheduled cesarean delivery under neuraxial anesthesia.
